California Lawmakers Pass Bills on Social Media, AI, and Other Issues

California lawmakers have passed numerous bills addressing various issues, including restrictions on social media use by minors and regulations for artificial intelligence. The state legislature also approved a ban on electric-shock gloves and new rules for hiring former immigration officers. A proposed wildfire liability bill, however, stalled in the Assembly after some lawmakers felt it did not sufficiently address victim compensation. The legislative session saw significant activity in areas such as technology regulation and public safety measures.
